csv_scope_of_work: RFP for the County to contract with a qualified and experienced transportation management consulting firm to conduct, on the basis of fixed hourly rates, a variety of planning, analysis, engineering design, system integration, software maintenance/development and related services, to supplement in-house staff for enhancement and integration of some or all of these functions. The Contractor must provide all services as directed in writing by the County's Contract Administrator. The County makes no guarantee that all or any of the services will be utilized. Comprehensive services which the Contractor agrees to provide to the County on an as needed basis include, but are not limited to, the following: 1. Intelligent Transportation Systems Engineering 2. Program/Project Management Services 3. Software planning, design, development and deployment 4. Software maintenance 5. Consulting services to support the deployment of the County's ATMS 6. Management, expiration tracking and payment of software licenses or maintenance agreements for existing and future ATMS software needs as specified by the County 7. Management of hardware and software maintenance licenses and support of the computer equipment and networks that comprise the ATMS
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, ITS Design

project_scope: As-needed countywide transportation management support for Montgomery County, including planning, analysis, engineering design, system integration, software maintenance and development, and support for the County's Advanced Transportation Management System (ATMS). Scope includes intelligent transportation systems engineering, software deployment, maintenance of ATMS-related software and hardware licenses, and support for computer equipment and networks. No specific physical structure, span, area, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Transportation management consulting; ITS engineering; planning and analysis; engineering design; system integration; software planning, design, development and deployment; software maintenance; ATMS deployment support; program/project management services; hardware and software license management.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style as-needed consulting contract without a defined structural project.
- Focus is on ITS, software, ATMS, and project management rather than structural engineering.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special load-bearing structure is described.
- Includes civil engineering in disciplines requested, but the actual scope is dominated by transportation systems and software services.
- Matches sbp exclusion tendencies for pure consulting/project management and non-structural technical services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. fee_explanation: No fee is stated. The procurement is an as-needed hourly-rate consulting contract with unspecified task volumes and no guaranteed utilization, so a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced transportation management consulting firm; experience in ITS engineering, program/project management, software planning/design/development/deployment, software maintenance, ATMS deployment support, and management of software and hardware maintenance licenses.
